| colspan="10" align="left" style="width:50px"| '''Notes:'''{{refbegin}}{{note|cursed|1}} After the marooning, no Reward challenge was held. Instead, all 22 new castaways competed in a special Challenge to avoid being sent to the Cursed Island.<br />{{note|tie|2}} The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote was held.<br />{{note|necklace|3}} An Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.<br />{{note|ambassadors|4}} At the ambassadors meeting, the two ambassadors agreed to vote Emmanuelle out of the game.<br />{{note|tie|5}} With a deadlocked tie between Fabrice and Sarah, both of them were forced to draw rocks to determine who would be eliminated.<br />{{note|suddendeath|6}} Maud came in last in the special Reward Challenge and was directly eliminated from the game.<br />{{note|tieddestinies|7}}  Cassandre was Maxim's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when Maxime was voted out.<br />{{note|cursedtribe|8}} After their elimination, Cassandre and Maxim were sent to the Cursed Tribe island to fight in a duel for another chance in the game.<br />{{note|suddendeath2|9}} Sophia came in last in the special Immunity Challenge and was directly eliminated from the game.<br />{{note|final5|10}} At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Jacques and Cécile B. came in last and were eliminated.<br />{{refend}}
